structure: Prologue: clamp the height cut-off via 0x00A44344 (+0xDFC, FISTP qword), compute the frame stamp from 0x00C10380, call 0x004C5810 to reset the token state, then derive the sector extent from the two saved angles with x87 fpatan/fcos.

LOD setup: for each of the five table slots {0,1,2,4,5}, read context+0x10+slot*4; when non-null, copy 0x40 bytes into 0x00A4EF38+slot*0x40, store the node at +0x0C, copy the eight dwords +0x0C..+0x2C in reverse, reverse the visibility bits at +0x30, publish the traversal root, and OR 1<<(0xA+slot) into the work flags. A null slot leaves P[k] uninitialised.

Main loop: the stack item holds {node, flags}. flags bit0 = merge phase, bits 7..9 = octave, bits 10+ = set of active LOD levels. The split phase sets bit0, runs the per-level split callbacks and allocation records, then walks the eight octants with the culling tests; the merge phase runs the merge callbacks, undoes the corner/extent state, pops and continues.

Octant culling: centre_x/y/z = corner_view[octant][axis] >> (level+1) + view_corner[axis]; height cut-off uses corner_z_level = corner_z + (corners[octant][2] >> (level+1)), half_extent = 0x40000000 >> (level+1), and top_z = corner_z_level + half_extent + camera_z. Then world_x/y = corner_x/y + (corners[octant][0/1] >> (level+1)); the max-abs component, the level detail shift (level_shift+0x19)&0x1F, and the detail*angle<9600 test decide visibility.

Hierarchy/hash: for an octant present in the child mask, child_record = record_base + child_slot*0x20; subdivide while detail < detail_threshold and level+1 < 16, otherwise hash the camera-relative corner and probe 0x00B04340 with a 0x800-entry linear wrap.

Record append: 0x30-byte records ending at the cursor, written in reverse: +0x2C entry pointer, +0x28 token high, +0x24 token low|0xFFFF, +0x20 child category, +0x1C child id, +0x18 level+1, +0x10/+0x08/+0x00 key_z/key_y/key_x as doubles.

After the traversal: restore the five LOD nodes from 0x00A4EF38, publish the record/descriptor counts, and sweep all 0x800 cache entries; reclaim entries whose stamp is not the previous frame and whose low half is stale, returning pool slots through the three pools, then clear data and stamp = 0xFFFFFFFF.

Block/edge counts split at every branch target and after every branch/return and exclude the trailing alignment NOPs; the same script reproduces the previously recorded 1700 instructions / 168 blocks / 267 edges for the pre-fix object, so the new 1701 / 169 / 268 is a like-for-like measurement: the correction adds one instruction, one block and one edge. The .text extent grew from 0x20A0 to 0x20C0 bytes including alignment padding. code_extent_bytes is the .text extent minus the final alignment byte, the same convention as the pre-fix record; nm reports the symbol size as 0x20C0 = 8384.

function.unwind_frame: The candidate function has a non-empty 4-byte .gcc_except_table and registers an SJLJ frame at entry (personality ___gxx_personality_sj0); retail has no unwind frame. The registration is GCC's 32-bit Windows exception model for a function that calls potentially-throwing functions.
function.worklist: fixed WorkItem worklist[128] on the stack. 128 is retail's own capacity: the base is ebp-0x408 (0x004D1A20 lea esi,[esp+0x240]) and the topmost local is var_8 at ebp-0x8, i.e. 0x400 bytes = 128 eight-byte entries with no other local inside the interval. The proved maximum live occupancy is 1 + 8*15 = 121, so the array cannot overflow under the executed algorithm; the proof is recorded in the QT-D5 divergence entry.
function.level_shift_sites: Object-level confirmation of the correction. Pre-fix object: the corner_z_level/world_x/world_y shifts read the `level` slot (movzbl 0x90(%esp) at 0x13ea, 0x14bd, 0x14e5) while half_extent uses a separate level+1 count (0x140d), exactly the QT-D1 split. divergences.summary: The candidate worklist is a fixed 128-entry array; the maximum live occupancy is proved to be 121, so the capacity is sufficient.
divergences.retail: worklist base esp+0x240 (0x004D1A20 lea esi,[esp+0x240]) = ebp-0x408; the region up to var_8 at ebp-0x8 is 0x400 bytes = 128 eight-byte entries; no bounds check
divergences.candidate: WorkItem worklist[128]; worklist[++top] with no check, same as retail
divergences.impact: None after the proof. The octant loop runs eight times and the iteration contains a single shared push block (0x004D22B1..0x004D22D0): the subdivide path jumps to it at 0x004D209F, and the mark path reaches it at 0x004D22A2 only when var_628_6 is non-zero (0x004D22A8), so at most one entry is pushed per octant and at most eight entries are live per level. The root occupies level 0, an entry is processed only at level+1 (0x004D1D37), and the subdivision site refuses level+1 >= 0x10 (0x004D2085..0x004D208D), so the child-mask/record path never creates an entry above level 15. The mark path is not level-guarded, but a push from level 15 would create a level-16 entry whose split half descends P[k] by one more node (0x004D1C74..0x004D1C7E) and reads [child+0x30] at 0x004D1C82; at the last level that child is null, so the executed algorithm cannot take the push. The shared push block is therefore capped at level 15: 1 + 8*15 = 121 <= 128.
divergences.resolution: Proved bound 121 <= 128. The array keeps retail's own 128 entries and no synthetic guard is added, so the candidate stays structurally faithful; the proof is also in the source comment at kWorklistCapacity. Residual premise: if a hierarchy supplied a deeper LOD node chain, the unguarded mark push could exceed 121; that input is not established by this function (see limitations).
